images.alt: A heartwarming Norman Rockwell–inspired illustration of a friendly female New York City police officer kneeling on a classic brownstone stoop while issuing a humorous citation to an irresistibly adorable fluffy tabby kitten. She wears a meticulously detailed vintage navy NYPD uniform with polished brass badge, leather duty belt, classic service revolver in a traditional holster, and a clearly legible shoulder patch reading “POLICE DEPARTMENT – CITY OF NEW YORK.” Smiling warmly, she writes in a citation notebook as the kitten clutches a ticket reading “VIOLATION – Unlawful Loitering” and meows in adorable protest beneath a weathered “NO LOITERING” sign. Warm brick brownstones, wrought-iron railings, flowers, vintage cars, pedestrians, and golden late-afternoon sunlight create rich nostalgic Americana. Museum-quality painterly realism with expressive faces, lifelike fur, impeccable anatomy, richly textured brushwork, cinematic storytelling, warm color harmonies, and a square composition, with all text crisp and fully legible.
